Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National ‘The players are very motivated’ – GoldStars SC boss confident ahead of Samartex clash Source : Ruth Akoto-Donkor 30 October 2026 2:17pm Audio By Carbonatix
Head coach of Bibiani GoldStars SC Petros Koukouras says his side is motivated ahead of the regional derby against FC Samatex 1996 in the Ghana Premier League.
The Miners secured a 2-1 win over Heart of Lions on matchweek eight and are occupying the 12th position in the league standings with 10 points from eight matches.
In an interview with GoldStars TV, Koukouras stated that the team is prepared to face their rivals and are hoping to make a statement.
"Yeah, the players are very motivated. It's one of the derbies, and we want to prove that the last few good results," he said.
"They didn't come by luck. So, everyone is ready for the game. And they really want to prove the point."
He highlighted that he will not entirely change their style of play but will keep using their attacking approach despite it being a derby.
The Greek tactician, however, recognised that there may be some tactical adjustments that may be key for an away fixture.
“You know, for us it's another game, although in the derby we approach it as a normal game. It can only give us three points, or we can only lose three points," he added.
"So the principles of play should remain the same as we had from the beginning of the season. They might be a little bit different because it's an away game. But we're not going to go there to defend. We should go to attack and score goals and try to win whatever positive result we can get there."
GoldStars SC will face FC Samartex 1996 on Sunday, November 1, at Nsenkyire Sports Arena at 3:00 pm.
